units: M. Kat. 18ᵃ quot. s. v. טַעֲמָא, a. T’shuboth G’onim ed. Cassel, p. 22ᵃ) reason, argument (on the cause of grief), consolation.—Pl. טַמַּיָּא, or טָמַיָּא.—בֵּי ט׳ gathering of comforters around the mourner in his house or at the place of worship.

<cite ref="Berakhot 6b:14">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>אגרא דבי ט׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="I00529"><he>טמא</he></cite>, Tshub. G’onim l. c. <he>טעמא</he>) the merit of attending the mourner’s gathering lies in the silence (which must be observed until the mourner begins to speak).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 113a:7">Snh. 113ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>למשאל ביה ט׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), v. <cite ref="I00612"><he>טַעֲמָא</he></cite>.
